elaine: FYI overnight we had vendor auth rate-limit 429s in us-west2 -> model-registry reads retried -> brief cascade of 5xx. opening follow-up for owners.

sam: saw it. how bad for Dedicated customers?

elaine: ~3% 5xx for ~40m, four Dedicated tenants saw latency spikes. no data loss.

priya: vendor admits they pushed a policy change that mis-keyed rate limits; investigating config drift.

jon: matches prior "token-storm" pattern. recurring issue. recommend treating as incident class.

marta: logged customer notes; opening vendor ticket.

elaine: proposed actions:
- Short: increase local token cache TTL (30s -> 5m) + jittered backoff. owner: priya. due: 2970090000.
- Mid: token circuit-breaker + fallback provider behind feature flag. owner: sam. due: 2971200000.
- Vendor: ask for SLA credit, dedicated key, and postmortem. owner: marta. due: 2970040000.
- Runbook: detection rule for auth 429 bursts + mitigation steps. owner: jon. due: 2970060000.

priya: taking short-term PR now.

sam: will design circuit-breaker options and cost tradeoffs.

marta: vendor ticket opened (#VND-821). drafting comms.

ops-bot: Actions logged INC-2038: https://tracker.internal/INC-2038

elaine: schedule weekly resilience check-ins for 4 weeks, then monthly. @sam to schedule.

sam: will send invites.

elaine: reconvene Friday EOD for status. treat recurrence as trend on resilience board.

priya: ack.

sam: ack.

jon: ack.
